title: Este Bench | Shadow Brown
body_html:
Pull up a seat. Or two. The Este 55.5" Bench brings sculptural curves and seriously soft seating wherever you put it. Fully upholstered in Shadow Brown performance velvet, its pillowy top sits on two chunky cylindrical legs for a silhouette that feels more like a piece of soft sculpture than your average bench. Place it at the end of the bed, give an empty hallway something to talk about, or pull it up to the dining table to comfortably seat two. Better yet, the easy-clean performance velvet means it’s ready for everyday use.

  • Fully upholstered in an easy clean performance velvet.
  • Kiln-dried solid wood and engineered hardwood frame with reinforced joinery, ensuring longevity.
  • Tight-fixed cushioning has a fiber-wrapped, high-resilience foam core.
  • Arrives fully assembled.

title: Aspen 157" Modular 6-Piece L-Shaped Sectional | Linen White
body_html:
Prepare to float on cloud nine with our Aspen Modular Sofa, the seating solution dreams are made of. Endlessly modular and re-arrangeable, it's like having your own personal seating cloud. With cushions so soft, they make marshmallows jealous, and fabrics so eco-friendly, even Mother Nature approves. Crafted for durability and comfort, it's the ultimate lounge buddy for all your movie marathons and lazy Sundays. And guess what? No assembly required, just sit back, relax, and let the Aspen carry you away.
  • Set includes three corner pieces and three armless chairs.
  • Water-repellent and stain-resistant covers featuring Repelis coating technology, free of harmful PFAS chemicals. Designed to withstand and temporarily repel common household spills including water, coffee, sodas, juices, soy sauce, energy drinks, pet urine, dirt, and wine.
  • Reversible, easily removable and washable cushion covers enable cleaning when they become soiled. Dry clean or machine wash at home using a cold and delicate cycle. Air dry or tumble dry with no heat, and avoid using bleach.
  • Endlessly modular & re-arrangeable into any configuration with the ability to add additional seats as needed.
  • Free from harmful fluorine compounds (PFAS/PFOA/PFC), formaldehyde, melamine derivatives, and free from APEO's.
  • Our fabrics are OEKO-TEX certified (Certificate Number: 13.HCN.35063 TESTEX) meaning they have undergone thorough testing to ensure they are devoid of harmful chemicals commonly present in performance fabrics.
  • Kiln-dried solid wood and engineered hardwood frame ensuring longevity. Heavy-gauge sinuous spring and Pirelli webbing base support.
  • Pirelli Webbing back support.
  • Seat cushions are filled with a high-resilience foam core wrapped in a hypoallergenic down alternative.
  • The back cushions are filled with a hypoallergenic down alternative.
  • Discreet silicone grip rings on the base of each foot keep your sectional seamlessly aligned and perfectly in place.
  • Arrives fully assembled.
